question.text: Which of the following has the dimension if $\left[\mathrm{ML}^{2} \mathrm{T}^{-2}\right] ?$

solution.text:
$\because$ Surface tension $(T)=$ Work done per unit area
$$
\begin{aligned}
\therefore \quad T &=\frac{d W}{d A} \\
&=\frac{F \cdot d x}{d A} \quad\left(\mathrm{FL}^{-1}=\mathrm{MT}^{-2}\right.
\end{aligned}
$$
$\therefore$ Dimension of surface tension $=\mathrm{ML}^{2} \mathrm{T}^{-2}$
